summary: Frontend-only validation (Playwright, cookie-injected sessions) of 3 new features: (1) Guide Console role-fix panel, (2) Expedition rename with stable join code, (3) Skill Studio checkpoint routing on last lesson of a block. All 3 features work as specified. Guide session em_guide_tok, explorer session em_exp_tok. One UX gap found: the 'Take the Checkpoint' button is shown even after a FAILING submission, sending the student to a locked assessment dead-end.

design_issues.screen: Skill Studio result modal (last mission of a block) -> /assessment/<cpId>
issues: studio-result-checkpoint-btn renders regardless of the submission result. Submitting email-m2 with grade F / 0% still shows 'Take the Checkpoint'; clicking it navigates to /assessment/email-cp1 which returns 403 and renders the dead-end screen 'Can't start this test — Finish the lessons in this block before taking the checkpoint'. Suggest gating the button on result.mastery (or showing the checkpoint's locked_reason inline / offering 'Keep editing' as primary when not mastered).

action_items: Optional UX fix: only surface 'Take the Checkpoint' when the student actually passed/mastered the final block mission (result.mastery true) or when the checkpoint reports unlocked; otherwise keep 'Next mission'/'Keep editing' so students don't hit the locked assessment screen.
critical_code_review_comments: StudioMission.jsx: nextCheckpointId derivation is correct (uses checkpoint.covers order-sorted last mission), but the result modal ignores pass/mastery state when choosing the primary CTA — see design_issues.
StudioMission.jsx load effect fires an extra GET /assessments/track/<track> on every mission open; consider caching per track to avoid duplicate requests.

(3) /studio/email/email-m2 submit -> result modal shows ONLY studio-result-checkpoint-btn labelled 'Take the Checkpoint', click navigates to /assessment/email-cp1; /studio/email/email-m1 submit -> ONLY studio-result-next-btn 'Next mission'. Note: studio submit returns a sticky BEST score (email-m1 returned grade A/100 with 0/2 tasks passed because em-exp mastered it earlier) — expected behavior, not a bug.
rca_of_the_issue: Checkpoint dead-end: StudioMission.jsx line ~244 renders studio-result-checkpoint-btn purely from nextCheckpointId, without consulting whether the block is complete/mastered; the assessment start endpoint independently enforces unlock (403 + locked_reason 'Finish the 4 lessons in this block first'), producing the mismatch.
